purpose: Owner Decision Review Pack comparison view (derived, read-only). Not a decision.

metricDefinitions.bakesToNDiscoveries: total bakes (incl. repeat bakes for Pitz) when the Nth recipe is discovered
metricDefinitions.grindBakes: repeat bakes of already-known recipes needed only to afford a fee/purchase
metricDefinitions.longestDrySpellBakes: max bakes between two consecutive new discoveries
metricDefinitions.capabilityFeesPaid: A_PAID only: unlockFeesPaid(A) - unlockFeesPaid(B) for the same curve/quality

simulationCaveats: All 24 scenarios use one fixed gate profile (sequence%4 rotation of star/discovery/completed/earned-Pitz); gate policy itself is not varied.
In the model, progress gates never bind (thresholds <= 60% of prior discoveries); only Pitz binds, so speed differences come from fees/prices.
Discovery is instant once a recipe is reachable (perfect-knowledge player); real search time is not modelled.
Quality ★1 = 20 Pitz/bake + 50 discovery bonus, 2 stars/discovery; ★3 = 80 Pitz/bake, 3 stars/discovery.
Unknown k is symbolic (k=1), so refill totals are not a balance claim.
